title: Alberino measures the Tombs of the Giants

tellings.quote: I went to Sardinia with a tape measure and yes, you can fit the bodies of giants in those tombs.

plain: The ancient stone tombs on the Italian island of Sardinia known as the Tombs of the Giants are said to be big enough to hold the bodies of real giants. Tim Alberino, a researcher who says he went there himself with a tape measure, reports: "yes, you can fit the bodies of giants in those tombs." He tells it to back up his view that giants once lived on Earth.
